evidence_required: FT-003-AC-011 RED: no source-managed non-destructive check proves display-independent central roles; GREEN: with no KDE, Chromium or display login, backend, worker and realtime start ready, a task-owned authenticated backend probe succeeds, a task-owned queued Photo reaches its expected owner transition and a fresh task-owned realtime request reaches admission, while starting/stopping the display session leaves every central role available; decisive comparison: scripts/check-ft003-recovery.sh records redacted readiness/probe/transition results before, during and after display-session changes, then cleans its disposable display-client, serving-context, Attempt and Photo fixtures; artifact: redacted reports under .tasks/TASK-051-T3-FT-003-W4/.
purpose: Supply the central-runtime recovery check and prove server roles operate independently of the local display session.
success_outcome: Central roles remain ready and operational without or across display-session changes, using reproducible redacted disposable probes.
anti_goals: Do not implement browser restart, kiosk hardening or runbook execution.
Do not mutate or delete operator/default product, serving or credential state.

forbidden_scope: Operator/default persistent rows and non-test external resources
Browser user service owned by TASK-054-T3-FT-003-W5
Runbook execution evidence owned by TASK-056-T3-FT-003-W6
stop_conditions: A central role depends on the display session.
A required probe cannot use isolated disposable state with reliable cleanup.
The check would expose protected payloads or mutate operator/default state.

constraints: The command is non-destructive to operator/default state and redacts credentials, protected payloads and raw storage paths.
It may create exactly its own disposable display client, serving context, Attempt and Photo transition needed by the probes and must clean all of them on success/failure.
Retain redacted reports under the task directory.
invariants: Central readiness never depends on KDE, Chromium or a display login.
Only task-owned disposable durable fixtures are created or mutated, and cleanup is safe to repeat.
Operator/default product, serving and credential state is never changed or deleted.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-011 no-display readiness and operational probes.
Fixture ownership/cleanup audit plus redacted command review.
